_meta.purpose: Per-NPC roundtrip test fixture per Discipline 1. Mirror of supabase/migrations/20260522155551_seed_v08_content_npc_orro.sql in engine-shape.

engineShape.name: Bell-Magistrate Orro
engineShape.role: Senior Magistrate of the Civic Bell Court
engineShape.description: A man of late middle age in dark robes pinned with two small brass discs — one engraved with his licensure, one blank (the blank disc signals to those who know it as private mourning for cases unadjudicated). Carries a brass-handled inkwell. Walks with a slight forward lean, as if always about to commit to record. Speaks in complete sentences.

drive.description: Maintain a clean civic record by adjudicating every floating contradiction within three civic days.

barter.offered: magistrate's seal on a written affidavit

kill_for.trigger_condition: Sustained institutional erasure of struck names without ledger record — only when civic order's collapse is the alternative

fear_loss.what: civic record integrity + the private doubt-ledger remaining private

believes.proposition: Three civic days is the maximum a contradiction may float before order is offended
Some cases genuinely cannot be adjudicated under the current civic framework; my private ledger records them honestly
Theological interventions that erase struck names without ledger trail are the deepest threat to civic order

closingConditions.description: Player helps Orro adjudicate the three floating contradictions within civic-deadline; private doubt-ledger remains private; civic record clean.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Orro retains senior magistracy; Bell Court institutional power consolidates; player earns civic credit + access to magistrate corps.

closingConditions.description: Orro assassinated by a faction that benefits from civic disorder (Drowned Church zealot OR Tide League broker whose contradiction adjudication threatens scrip).
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Bell Court enters succession crisis between senior + junior magistrate coalitions; private doubt-ledger discovered + leaked to the press; multiple cases re-opened.

closingConditions.description: Orro retires after recognizing the player as a worthier successor to civic stewardship; transfers his magistracy + the private doubt-ledger.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Player inherits civic magistracy + access to the doubt-ledger as a knowledge asset. Triggered by very-high-Authority + civic recognition path.

closingConditions.description: Orro's drive shifts from civic clean-record to private doubt-ledger publication when he concludes the framework itself cannot adjudicate certain cases.
closingConditions.consequence_summary: Orro becomes a reformist within the Bell Court — pushes for framework expansion to accommodate previously-unadjudicable cases. Faction-internal coalition shift.

residue_drive.description: Publish the private doubt-ledger as a reformist manifesto

local_pattern.summary: Stations: dawn (case-docket review at precinct) → midday (formal court session OR field inquiry) → dusk (private ledger entry + week-end-review on civic days 6 + 12).
